text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the favorable results we achieved in the practice match, the team's motivation shoots up significantly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon and Bitter Glasse stop by to watch our training and start fearing that they'll lose against us if they only do as Ms. Kashimoto says.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If our team's rallying cause is friendship, then theirs will be their trainer, Ms. Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shortly after, Ms. Kashimoto stumbles upon Team Zenith doing supplementary training without her approval.
